title: bogota-devnet-1
announcements:
**Scope.** Second devnet for [EIP-8141 Frame Transactions](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8141), adding the frame-tx companion EIPs [EIP-8250 Keyed Nonces](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8250), [EIP-8272 Recent Roots](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8272) and [EIP-7906 Transaction Assertions](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7906). Formerly bogota-devnet-1; the frames devnets are now bogota-devnet-*.
EL-only feature devnet: the EL activates **Bogota** at the Heze fork epoch while the CL side of Heze is suppressed (`FRAMES_ENABLED=true` in ethereum-genesis-generator).
Clients at genesis: geth, reth, ethrex (EL) + lighthouse (CL). nethermind and besu join as non-validating nodes until their branches pass (see [Clients](#Clients)).
